description: Get one request by id, with its status now: `pending`, `completed`, `cancelled` or `expired`. A completed one names the mailbox it connected or changed. A `send_lead_anyway` request names its `campaignId` and `contactId`, and `cancelled` can also mean the person declined it. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes sees only the requests it made; any other answers 404.
name: get_handoff
title: Get a request
